title: StoneCharts Chart Spec
description: Language-agnostic recipe for one chart. Unknown keys are ignored (forward-compatible); renderers grow field support phase by phase. Keep language spec models (libs/*/spec) in lockstep with this file.

type.description: Chart type id for the active release scope (0.0.0.1: line, column, area; 0.0.0.2 admits bar per DEC-014; 0.0.0.3 admits scatter per DEC-015; 0.0.0.4 admits bubble per DEC-016; 0.0.0.5 admits combo; 0.0.0.6 admits histogram per DEC-021; 0.0.0.7 admits candlestick per DEC-022; 0.0.0.8 admits error-bar per DEC-023; 0.0.0.9 admits arearange per DEC-024 and columnrange per DEC-025; 0.0.0.10 admits waterfall per DEC-026; 0.0.0.11 admits bullet per DEC-027; 0.0.0.12 admits boxplot per DEC-028; 0.0.0.13 admits lollipop per DEC-029; 0.0.0.14 admits dumbbell per DEC-030; 0.0.0.15 admits funnel per DEC-031; 0.0.0.16 admits variwide per DEC-032; 0.0.0.17 admits timeline per DEC-033; 0.0.0.18 admits windbarb per DEC-034; 0.0.0.19 admits streamgraph per DEC-035; 0.0.0.20 admits vector-plot per DEC-036; 0.0.0.21 admits xrange per DEC-037; 0.0.0.22 admits technical-indicators per DEC-038; 0.0.0.23 admits flame-chart per DEC-039; 0.0.0.24 admits pie per DEC-040; 0.0.0.25 admits gauge per DEC-041; 0.0.0.26 admits solid-gauge per DEC-042; 0.0.0.27 admits radar per DEC-043; 0.0.0.28 admits polar per DEC-044; 0.0.0.29 admits wind-rose per DEC-045; 0.0.0.30 admits nightingale per DEC-046; 0.0.0.31 admits radial-bar per DEC-047; 0.0.0.32 admits parliament per DEC-048); maps to the released chart design and renderer pair.

id.description: Chart instance id, used to namespace <defs> ids (gradients/patterns) so multiple charts on one page don't collide. Set a unique value per chart when embedding several.

theme.description: Color theme. A built-in name ('light' = default, byte-identical to the classic look; 'dark'), or a full theme object. Resolved server-side into concrete SVG attributes (never CSS variables).

responsive.description: When true the SVG scales to its container (viewBox + preserveAspectRatio + width:100%) instead of a fixed pixel size. Default false keeps fixed width/height.

a11y.description: Accessibility (on by default): SVG gets role="img" + a summary aria-label + <desc>; the HTML output adds a visually-hidden data table. Set false to restore the pre-a11y byte output.

layout.description: Manual chart layout controls. Margin values override the deterministic defaults only when present; they never auto-fit text.

stacking.description: Stack series values per category. 'normal' = absolute stacked with signed positive/negative accumulators, 'percent' = 100% stacked using non-negative values only. Absent = no stacking.

grouping.description: When true (default) multi-series bars/columns sit side-by-side; when false they overlay.

secondaryYAxis.description: Optional second value axis (dual units), drawn on the right. Same shape as yAxis. Series bind to it with series[].yAxis: 1.

bulletTarget.description: Bullet chart: comparative target value, drawn as a tick mark across the measure bar.

bulletRanges.description: Bullet chart: qualitative range bounds (sorted ascending). Defines graded background bands from 0 to each bound.

orientation.description: Coordinate orientation. 'vertical' (default) = categories on x, values on y. 'horizontal' = categories on y, values on x.

scatterOverlay.description: Boxplot: when true and samples are present, jittered raw sample points are drawn over each box.

speedUnit.description: Windbarb: wind speed unit for tooltip/label. Values: kt (knots), mps (m/s), mph, kmh.

calmThreshold.description: Windbarb: speeds below this render as the calm glyph (open circle, no staff).

hemisphere.description: Windbarb: N (Northern, feathers right) or S (Southern, feathers left).

barbLength.description: Windbarb: staff length of the barb glyph in pixels.

yOffset.description: Windbarb: pixel offset of the barb lane from the plot-area vertical center.

offset.description: Streamgraph: baseline-offset mode. 'wiggle' = minimal-wiggle spine (classic streamgraph); 'silhouette' = inside-out centered stack spanning [-T/2, +T/2] at each x.

vectorLength.description: Vector-plot: max arrow pixel length. The longest magnitude maps to this many pixels; every other arrow scales linearly.

rotationOrigin.description: Vector-plot: where the arrow pivots on its (x,y) anchor. 'center' = midpoint at anchor, 'start' = tail at anchor, 'end' = head at anchor.

flags.description: Technical-indicators: event markers anchored along the base plot.

title.description: Short label shown on the flag glyph.

gaugeMin.description: Gauge: minimum value on the gauge scale.

gaugeMax.description: Gauge: maximum value on the gauge scale.

gaugeBands.description: Gauge: colored range bands on the gauge arc.

panes.description: Technical-indicators: vertical split of the plot area into stacked panes. panes[0] = base pane; panes[1..] = oscillator panes.

height.description: Pane height as a fraction (0..1) of the available plot area.

theme.description: Concrete color set. Canonical values live in spec/themes/*.json; a custom object may override any field. Omitted fields fall back to the light theme.

gradient.description: Linear gradient. Direction is x1,y1 -> x2,y2 in 0..1 objectBoundingBox coords (default 0,0 -> 0,1 = vertical top-to-bottom). No trig, so both renderers format it identically.

pattern.description: Hatch (diagonal-line) fill for the area under the line. Print- and colorblind-friendly. Renders as an SVG <pattern> tile.

background.description: Optional solid tile background behind the hatch lines.

categories.description: Category labels. On xAxis, index i of each series maps to categories[i].

plotBands.description: Shaded regions spanning a range on this axis.

plotLines.description: Reference lines at a specific value on this axis.

gridLine.description: Horizontal gridline styling. Defaults reproduce the built-in look (solid #e8e8ee).

plotLines.description: Horizontal reference lines at a value.

data.description: y-values; x comes from xAxis.categories (or 0..n-1). scatter (0.0.0.3, DEC-015) additionally accepts the point model: a positional [x,y] pair or an {x,y} object. bubble (0.0.0.4, DEC-016) additionally accepts [x,y,z] / {x,y,z}. Every other chart type is restricted back to a plain number, and scatter/bubble are each restricted to their own shape, by the type-conditional rules below.

color.description: Series color: a hex string, or a linear-gradient object (fades between stops). Gradient applies to the stroke and area fill; markers/legend use the first stop's color.

fillOpacity.description: Fill the area under the line down to the zero baseline at this opacity. 0 = no fill (default). Any value > 0 turns a line chart into an area chart.

step.description: Draw as a stepped line instead of straight segments.

curve.description: Line interpolation. 'monotone' = smooth Fritsch-Carlson spline (no overshoot). Default = straight segments.

marker.description: Data-point markers. Defaults reproduce the built-in circle (r 3.5).

type.description: Per-series mark kind. 'column' = baseline-anchored rect; 'line' = path + markers; 'area' = path + fill down to the pane floor.

volume.description: Technical-indicators: per-record volume, aligned to data by index. Required only for a VWAP indicator.

indicators.description: Technical-indicators: derived overlays computed from this series' data. Each element names a transform type and its parameters.

yAxis.description: Which value axis this series is measured against: 0 = primary yAxis (default), 1 = secondaryYAxis.

boxData.description: Boxplot: 5-number summary per category. Each element is {low, q1, median, q3, high, outliers?}.

samples.description: Boxplot: raw sample arrays per category (renderer computes the 5-number summary).

labels.description: Timeline: per-event label text, aligned to data by index.

x.description: Vector-plot: per-point numeric x-coordinate, aligned to data (y) by index. If omitted, x defaults to 0-based index.

direction.description: Windbarb/vector-plot: per-point direction in degrees, aligned to data by index. Windbarb: meteorological 'from' bearing (0-360). Vector-plot: arrow heading (0 = north/up, clockwise).

length.description: Vector-plot: per-point magnitude, aligned to data by index. Non-negative; drives arrow pixel length via the length-scale.

spans.description: X-range/Gantt: per-series span objects. Each span has {x, x2, y} required (start, end, lane index), plus optional id, name, dependency (array of predecessor ids), milestone (bool).

x.description: Span start value (datetime epoch or numeric).

x2.description: Span end value (datetime epoch or numeric).

id.description: Unique span identifier for dependency linking.

dependency.description: Array of predecessor span ids (finish-to-start connectors).

milestone.description: If true, render as a diamond marker instead of a bar.

frames.description: Flame-chart: per-series call-frame objects. Each frame has {x, x2, depth} required (start, end, stack depth), plus optional name and color.
